gloss: hot spring resort area; spa town

definitions.gloss: hot spring resort area; spa town
definitions.explanation: A locality known for its hot springs, typically with multiple inns, bathhouses, and tourist facilities centered on bathing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{温泉地|おんせんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a famous hot spring resort.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{温泉地|おんせんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This hot spring town has many traditional ryokan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{温泉地|おんせんち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわう。
examples.english: During the autumn foliage season, hot spring resort areas bustle with tourists.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) + {地|ち} (place, area). Refers to the whole resort town or region, not a single bath.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{温泉地|おんせんち}: a famous hot spring resort
- {温泉地|おんせんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧: to tour hot spring resorts
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温泉地|おんせんち}: a popular spa town
- ⟦{山間|さんかん}→山間：12589_sankan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温泉地|おんせんち}: a mountain hot spring resort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧: hot spring — the spring or bath itself, not the surrounding town
- ⟦{温泉街|おんせんがい}→温泉街：09228_onsengai⟧: hot spring district — emphasizes the streets and shops around the springs
